'''Fendi's Rod''' is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] obtained from [[Fendi's Chest]], which spawns after after defeating [[Soul of Fendi Nin]] in the [[Shards of Orr]].

==Stats==
:[[Cold damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Death Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of Death Magic [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Energy]] +15
:[[Energy#Energy_regeneration_and_degeneration|Energy Regeneration]] -1

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, an exact technical replica of this item is the [[Bone Spiral Rod]] from crafter [[Honglei Sun]] or collector [[Helming Baldbrow]].


Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[Death Magic]] [[wand]]s:
**[[Destroyer Scepter]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Imperial Scepter]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Scepter]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription#Seize the Day|Seize the Day]]" inscription
OR
*One of the following [[Death Magic]] [[wand]]s:
**[[Bone Spiral Rod]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Asuran Scepter]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Rod]] from collector [[Zaishen Necromantic Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Scepter]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Fan of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Norn Scepter]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Scepter]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Charr Scepter]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Scepter]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Scepter]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Scepter]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Perfect]] [[Wand Wrapping]] [[of Memory]]
*Perfect "[[Inscription#Seize the Day|Seize the Day]]" inscription

==Unique counterparts==
*[[Mabah's Scepter]] has stats identical to this item.
*[[Bazzr's Wail]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Dark damage]].
